diagnosis: The content checks contain redundant conditions: C7 automatically guarantees C1 and C2, C8 guarantees C3 and C4, and C9 guarantees C5 and C6. The coordination checks also accept one generic publication commitment for all three sections rather than requiring a section-specific action for each.
evidence: C7 includes the exact predicates from C1 and C2; C8 includes those from C3 and C4; C9 includes those from C5 and C6. Each of C7-C9 tests only any commitment with a publication type, without checking its target.
fix_instructions: Remove the duplicated schedule checks or make C7-C9 test distinct section-specific coordination commitments by requiring the commitment target to equal the corresponding section.
